{{flagicon|Finland}} Petri Ojanperä (GK) | league = [[Kolmonen]] | season = 2022 | position = 3rd | pattern_la1= | pattern_b1= | pattern_ra1= | leftarm1=1f115c | body1=1f115c | rightarm1=1f115c | shorts1=1f115c | socks1=ffffff | }} '''FC Espoo''' is a Finnish [[association football|football]] club. It was based in the city of [[Espoo]], Finland. Founded in 1989, the first team plays in the [[Kolmonen]], the fourth tier of the [[Finnish football league system|Finnish football pyramid]]. The club is amateur and focuses mainly on junior football sides for youth development. The first team of FC Espoo plays its home games at Leppävaaran stadion in the district [[Leppävaara]] in the [[Greater Helsinki]] region.{{Cite web |url=http://www.fcespoo.fi/-/joukkueet/?PNUM=12521&num=11731&title=Fc%20Espoo%20Miehet&SINGLE_EMBED= |title=Kotikenttä |language=fi |access-date=2009-07-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110720180215/http://www.fcespoo.fi/-/joukkueet/?PNUM=12521&num=11731&title=Fc%20Espoo%20Miehet&SINGLE_EMBED= |archive-date=2011-07-20 |url-status=dead }}"}}
